    FAQ

    Frequently asked questions

    Need a more specific answer? Our team can map it to your workflow.

    What does VictorySync handle?

    Our agents handle inbound support, cold calling, lead follow-up, qualification, and appointment setting. AI assists the team with summaries, prompts, routing, and reporting; people remain responsible for every customer conversation.

    Which businesses are the best fit?

    VictorySync works with US small and midsize businesses that need dependable conversation capacity, especially home services, real estate, SaaS, agencies, and professional services.

    Where are your agents and managers based?

    Agents are based in Cairo, Egypt. Onboarding, account management, quality standards, and campaign oversight are US-led.

    How do you train agents for our account?

    We document your ideal customer, offer, scripts, qualification criteria, objection handling, tools, escalation rules, and desired outcomes. Agents train on that playbook before launch and receive ongoing coaching.

    Can your team work inside our CRM and calendar?

    Yes. Depending on your stack and access policies, agents can work in common CRMs, calendars, ticketing systems, forms, and phone tools while following the permissions agreed during onboarding.

    How does pricing work?

    Pricing is based on agent count, coverage, channels, and workflow complexity. Dedicated agent engagements currently start from $10 per hour. A discovery call confirms the right scope before you commit.

    How fast can we launch?

    Straightforward campaigns can often launch within 24 to 48 hours after scripts, lists, access, and escalation rules are approved.
